title: Aquarium Boka concept design
reference: Vladica Simić, Igor Mirović, Radoje Laušević (2019): Aquarium Boka concept design. International Conference Adriatic Biodiversity Protection – AdriBioPro2019 7-10 April 2019, Kotor, Montenegro, Book of Abstracts
authors: Vladica Simić, Igor Mirović, Radoje Laušević
venue: International Conference Adriatic Biodiversity Protection – AdriBioPro2019 7-10 April 2019, Kotor, Montenegro, Book of Abstracts. Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro
publisher: Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro
description: Concept design of Aquarium Boka is developed as main input for setting up Marine Bio-diversity Conservation Center “Aquarium Boka” and Sea Turtle Rescue Centre in the Institute of Marine Biology in Kotor, Montenegro, financially supported by the Norwe-gian Ministry of Foreign Affairs through the project “MonteAqua” grant (http://www.aquariumboka.ucg.ac.me/). Concept design is developed as a first stage of the Executive project of comprehensive building reconstruction and construction of Aquarium Boka and Rescue Center.
